title: Встроить journal/audit wiring, snapshot provenance и collision/cardinality gate
summary: Подключить P5.2/P5.3 store к supported journal/audit path, провести redaction и metric-label policy и выпустить проверяемый receipt, что seq больше не назначает caller, а silent event-id no-op больше не скрывает collision.
why: Store CAS does not close F05 while `JournalAppender`, `AuditEventFactory`, conformance engines and SQLite still mint `ev-{action}-{seq}` and export the full document. `RAG:—`.

include: JournalAppender/AuditEventFactory UncommittedEvent path; redaction validator before append and on AuditSink export; closed metric cardinality helper; snapshot `seq`+`spec_rev`+content hash; consumer migration of reference/conformance paths; restart/multi-worker append gate; PHP/Dart parity receipt; residual notes for P6/P7/P8/P9.
exclude: P2 authorization redesign; P3 token consume; P4 lease/fencing; new spec revision; final barrel/PSR-4 removals; public docs/release; CQRS/outbox platform; claiming exactly-once consumer delivery; adding an OpenTelemetry SDK.

rules: Supported journal append goes through EventStore batch API. Omitting store is a construction error, not a silent in-memory caller-seq write. Event ids are CSPRNG, not seq-derived. AuditSink receives the redacted document or nothing; exporter exceptions do not roll back append. Metric helper rejects forbidden labels. Snapshot restore matches full fold; a mutated hash discards the snapshot without deleting events. Layer tests fail if a new `EventLog.append(ActionEvent)` or seq-derived id bypass reappears on migrated consumers. PostgreSQL concurrent-append test is mandatory for close; in-memory restart is not a substitute. Receipt derives case/result/code sets from real test output and names P6/P7/P8/P9 residual owners. No safe result claims exactly-once projection delivery.
guidance: Keep `ActionEvent` as the committed envelope. Optional `trace` lives in payload (AOB-17). Do not merge executor epoch into event_id or lease token. Redact tokens. Frozen harness may wrap a one-event batch so `2026-08` vectors still observe seq/kind without new spec bytes.
